title: The object and record map
description: The object tells you which runtime instance you have; its type and record tell you what that instance means.

nodes.title: Generic object handle
nodes.detail: A live instance somewhere in game state.

nodes.title: Concrete type
nodes.detail: Actor, Weapon, Door, Container, or another game category.

nodes.title: Instance identity and state
nodes.detail: The object ID identifies this particular runtime instance.

nodes.title: Location and lifetime
nodes.detail: Cell transitions and unloads can change whether the handle remains valid.

nodes.title: Content record
nodes.detail: The record ID identifies the definition the instance came from.
